title: An integer outside a literal union violates the parameter contract

ground_truth.statement: The declared finite set contains 3 but not 4. PHP erases the annotation; the runtime checks strict set membership independently, not whether PHP throws.

provenance.note: Read full dataset. Clean-room finite scalar union, using portable @param rather than @psalm-param. These are literal types, not native backed enums.

notes: The good call at line 6 is an asymmetric control. Shared criterion with the valid quoted-literal variant. Static annotation contracts are measured, not imposed on PHP runtime semantics. No diagnostic is allowed away.
